detail.longDescription: I've recently built a website and put it live. I checked it out on mobile as well and everything was okay, however, today I checked it out again and the images on mobile seem stretched out and a bit zoomed in. On my desktop browser its still fine and when I switch to mobile view on my desktop browser its still fine, its just when I check on my actual phone browser (Safari) that I notice this change. Is this a cache thing or am I dealing with something else, and if its a cache thing then how can I fix this for the user Thank you.
